paragraphs.text: Veko is a spirit priest aligned with the Orzhov , known for his role in manipulating life and death.

In his unlife, Veko wears long black and white robes, heavily adorned with gold, and a unique elaborate headpiece incorporating stained glass. His skin is blue and sagging, and he stands in possession of a portal out of the afterlife, allowing selected spirits to return to life, albeit in a weak form.
